translations.web: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.
translations.bsb: “I hate, I despise your feasts! I cannot stand the stench of your solemn assemblies.
translations.kjv: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.
translations.asv: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I will take no delight in your solemn assemblies.
